units.displayText: The warm lights, the sound of fabric rustling, girls whispering to each other, everything seems so gentle...

spans.text: The warm lights, the sound of fabric rustling, girls whispering to each other, everything seems so gentle...

units.rawText: At some point, I end up falling asleep.
units.displayText: At some point, I end up falling asleep.

spans.text: At some point, I end up falling asleep.

units.rawText: Professor, I've changed...
units.displayText: Professor, I've changed...

spans.text: Professor, I've changed...

units.rawText: ...Are you asleep?
units.displayText: ...Are you asleep?

spans.text: ...Are you asleep?

units.rawText: Wow, what a bad place to pick, he actually fell asleep in Riko's store...
units.displayText: Wow, what a bad place to pick, he actually fell asleep in Riko's store...

spans.text: Wow, what a bad place to pick, he actually fell asleep in Riko's store...

units.rawText: I can't open the Professor's room door without being authorized.
units.displayText: I can't open the Professor's room door without being authorized.

spans.text: I can't open the Professor's room door without being authorized.

units.rawText: Why not let them sleep here, then? Riko will simply collect lodging fees from him tomorrow.
units.displayText: Why not let them sleep here, then? Riko will simply collect lodging fees from him tomorrow.

spans.text: Why not let them sleep here, then? Riko will simply collect lodging fees from him tomorrow.

units.rawText: No need for that, I'll bring the Professor back to my room.
units.displayText: No need for that, I'll bring the Professor back to my room.

spans.text: No need for that, I'll bring the Professor back to my room.

units.rawText: Amidst the chaos that fills my mind, I suddenly feel my body lightening.
units.displayText: Amidst the chaos that fills my mind, I suddenly feel my body lightening.

spans.text: Amidst the chaos that fills my mind, I suddenly feel my body lightening.

units.rawText: It seems someone has picked me up in a princess carry and walked out of the place with the warm light.
units.displayText: It seems someone has picked me up in a princess carry and walked out of the place with the warm light.

spans.text: It seems someone has picked me up in a princess carry and walked out of the place with the warm light.

units.rawText: The morning sunlight filters in through the window, dying my closed eyelids red.
units.displayText: The morning sunlight filters in through the window, dying my closed eyelids red.

spans.text: The morning sunlight filters in through the window, dying my closed eyelids red.

units.rawText: ...It's morning already? When did I fall asleep last night? I don't remember a thing.
units.displayText: ...It's morning already? When did I fall asleep last night? I don't remember a thing.

spans.text: ...It's morning already? When did I fall asleep last night? I don't remember a thing.

units.rawText: Well, let's get up.
units.displayText: Well, let's get up.

spans.text: Well, let's get up.
(Open your eyes.)

units.rawText: Good morning, Professor.
units.displayText: Good morning, Professor.

spans.text: Good morning, Professor.

units.rawText: Evelyn comes into view, in a markedly different outfit from normal.
units.displayText: Evelyn comes into view, in a markedly different outfit from normal.

spans.text: Evelyn comes into view, in a markedly different outfit from normal.

units.rawText: She's lying close to me, her red pupil as clear as a gemstone.
units.displayText: She's lying close to me, her red pupil as clear as a gemstone.

spans.text: She's lying close to me, her red pupil as clear as a gemstone.

units.rawText: And she's holding... chocolate? And that must be a choker on her neck, it suits her very well...
units.displayText: And she's holding... chocolate? And that must be a choker on her neck, it suits her very well...

spans.text: And she's holding... chocolate? And that must be a choker on her neck, it suits her very well...

units.rawText: Hold on.
units.displayText: Hold on.

spans.text: Hold on.

units.rawText: Wait a minute...
units.displayText: Wait a minute...

spans.text: Wait a minute...

units.rawText: Hang on, Evelyn, where are we!?
units.displayText: Hang on, Evelyn, where are we!?

spans.text: Hang on, Evelyn, where are we!?

units.rawText: This is my room, Professor.
units.displayText: This is my room, Professor.

spans.text: This is my room, Professor.

units.rawText: You fell asleep at Riko's store yesterday, so I had no choice but to bring you to my place.
units.displayText: You fell asleep at Riko's store yesterday, so I had no choice but to bring you to my place.

spans.text: You fell asleep at Riko's store yesterday, so I had no choice but to bring you to my place.

units.rawText: I spring up from Evelyn's bed, but my muscle pain means it hurts so much I have no choice but to lie back down.
units.displayText: I spring up from Evelyn's bed, but my muscle pain means it hurts so much I have no choice but to lie back down.

spans.text: I spring up from Evelyn's bed, but my muscle pain means it hurts so much I have no choice but to lie back down.

units.rawText: Evelyn lies there placidly, still watching me.
units.displayText: Evelyn lies there placidly, still watching me.

spans.text: Evelyn lies there placidly, still watching me.

units.rawText: Don't worry. I didn't let Riko take the Diggcoins you had on you.
units.displayText: Don't worry. I didn't let Riko take the Diggcoins you had on you.

spans.text: Don't worry. I didn't let Riko take the Diggcoins you had on you.

units.rawText: That's not the point! You... I... Er...
units.displayText: That's not the point! You... I... Er...

spans.text: That's not the point! You... I... Er...

units.rawText: You looked so peaceful while you were sleeping. Don't worry, I only woke up a short while before you.
units.displayText: You looked so peaceful while you were sleeping. Don't worry, I only woke up a short while before you.

spans.text: You looked so peaceful while you were sleeping. Don't worry, I only woke up a short while before you.

units.rawText: Are these the clothes you chose last night?
units.displayText: Are these the clothes you chose last night?

spans.text: Are these the clothes you chose last night?

units.rawText: Yes. Helix and the others came by just a while ago to drop off some obligation chocolate as thanks for standing watch.
units.displayText: Yes. Helix and the others came by just a while ago to drop off some obligation chocolate as thanks for standing watch.

spans.text: Yes. Helix and the others came by just a while ago to drop off some obligation chocolate as thanks for standing watch.

units.rawText: Want to try it?
units.displayText: Want to try it?

spans.text: Want to try it?

units.rawText: ...Alright.
units.displayText: ...Alright.

spans.text: ...Alright.

units.rawText: Evelyn's expression is the same as usual, which makes me feel very abnormal by comparison.
units.displayText: Evelyn's expression is the same as usual, which makes me feel very abnormal by comparison.

spans.text: Evelyn's expression is the same as usual, which makes me feel very abnormal by comparison.

units.rawText: All I can do is accept the chocolate she is holding and savor its sweet (and slightly bitter) taste.
units.displayText: All I can do is accept the chocolate she is holding and savor its sweet (and slightly bitter) taste.

spans.text: All I can do is accept the chocolate she is holding and savor its sweet (and slightly bitter) taste.

units.rawText: Thank you for bringing me back, otherwise I'm sure Riko would have used that opportunity to soak me for all I was worth.
units.displayText: Thank you for bringing me back, otherwise I'm sure Riko would have used that opportunity to soak me for all I was worth.

spans.text: Thank you for bringing me back, otherwise I'm sure Riko would have used that opportunity to soak me for all I was worth.

units.rawText: Just doing my job. Don't worry about it.
units.displayText: Just doing my job. Don't worry about it.

spans.text: Just doing my job. Don't worry about it.

units.rawText: More importantly, Professor...
units.displayText: More importantly, Professor...

spans.text: More importantly, Professor...

units.rawText: This chocolate is pretty good... What is it?
units.displayText: This chocolate is pretty good... What is it?

spans.text: This chocolate is pretty good... What is it?

units.rawText: I have today off, so would you like to go walking around the post-festival Oasis with me?
units.displayText: I have today off, so would you like to go walking around the post-festival Oasis with me?

spans.text: I have today off, so would you like to go walking around the post-festival Oasis with me?

units.rawText: With the chocolate in my mouth, my affirmative is between my lips.
units.displayText: With the chocolate in my mouth, my affirmative is between my lips.

spans.text: With the chocolate in my mouth, my affirmative is between my lips.

units.rawText: This cocoa-sweet day has only just begun.
units.displayText: This cocoa-sweet day has only just begun.

spans.text: This cocoa-sweet day has only just begun.
